name: Volumetric Morphology
description: Enforce a minimum feature size: remove what is too thin, or fill what is too narrow.

inputParameters.name: vol
inputParameters.description: The starting solid. A process result runs on its own grid when bounds is unwired.

inputParameters.name: bounds
inputParameters.description: The box to sample vol over. Leave unwired to run on a process result's own grid.

inputParameters.name: resolution
inputParameters.description: Samples per axis. Defaults to 64. Sets the finest feature: below two voxels, nothing survives.

inputParameters.name: operation
inputParameters.description: open or close. Defaults to open.

inputParameters.name: radius
inputParameters.description: Half the thinnest feature to keep, or the widest gap to fill, in mm. Defaults to 1.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: False holds the last result while you change things upstream. Unwired, it runs.

outputParameters.name: result
outputParameters.description: The result: a volumetric object to combine, run another process on, or mesh.

outputParameters.name: history
outputParameters.description: How it was made, one operation per line.
